findings.round_2_evidence: Round-2 24-modal-pay-counter-confirm.png now correctly binds to the cart: TOTAL shows '1,50 €' (matching cart total from state 23), order id '#C-9279' (dynamically generated, not hardcoded C-1234), PRÊT À '08h07' (live ETA, not hardcoded 19h45). DOM contains 3 'C-1234' literals but they are inline JS fallback defaults inside transpiled <script> bodies (orderId ?? 'C-1234'), NOT in the rendered HTML output. The P0 fiscal-trust violation is resolved.

MD5 of 24-modal-pay-counter-confirm.png and 25-confirm-screen.png are STILL byte-identical (f93fa0e3533fb7b76ec5f1fe5fbd84fb).
